fetch_query: DFARS 252.204-7021 Level 1 self-assessment SPRS current CMMC status affirmation

webFetch_response.answer:
Regarding CMMC Level 1 (Self) assessments and the requirement for an affirmation of continuous compliance:

*   **Definition of Current:** A "Final Level 1 (Self)" CMMC status is considered "Current" if it is not older than 1 year, provided there are no changes in compliance with 32 CFR part 170 since the status date and there is a corresponding affirmation of continuous compliance by an affirming official that is also not older than 1 year [L56-L60].
*   **Affirmation Requirement:** The contractor must complete and maintain as current an annual affirmation of continuous compliance by an affirming official in the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) for each applicable CMMC UID [L110, L126].
